compute.basis: Requires installing Gurobi (commercial license) and FIPE's MILP pipeline, then running 5 seeds × 6 α values of iterative MILP solves; paper reports ~48 s per PINE run on Pima-Diabetes, but setup, debugging, and license issues dominate.

blockers: Gurobi commercial solver license required (free academic license possible but not guaranteed)

title: PINE: Pruning Boosted Tree Ensembles with Conformal In-Distribution Prediction Equivalence
